claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nabumetone is a non-acidic prodrug with no plausible cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; its active metabolite is a weak, non-selective COX inhibitor, and no member of the screened class vocabulary shares a killing pattern driven by COX inhibition, so it is expected to be largely inactive.
